name: study-rpg
description: Open-source gamified study RPG engine. Default content pack: Taiwan Stage-1 medical board exam (一階醫師國考).

scripts.build:cf: VITE_DEPLOY_BASE=/1st/ pnpm --filter @study-rpg/medexam-tw build && VITE_DEPLOY_BASE=/2nd/ VITE_SYNC_WORKER_URL=https://api.med-study-rpg.com pnpm --filter @study-rpg/medexam2-hospital-tw build && VITE_DEPLOY_BASE=/neurons/ VITE_SYNC_WORKER_URL=https://api.med-study-rpg.com pnpm --filter @study-rpg/neurons-tw build && node scripts/build-cf-pages-dist.mjs
scripts.deploy:cf: pnpm run build:cf && wrangler pages deploy dist-cf --project-name med-study-rpg --branch main --commit-dirty=true
